That arrangement changed in the final decade of Fath-Ali Shah's reign, which ended in 1834: Jandaq was transferred to Qumes, the region around Semnan. The district also gave its name to the poet Yaghma-yi Jandaqi, born in nearby Khur in 1781. His association with the district linked this desert country to Persian literary life during the same period in which its provincial allegiance changed.
simp_chinese:
琼达克又写作Jandaq，位于伊朗卡维尔盐漠南缘、胡尔与比亚巴纳克地区。聚落周围有孤立山体、泉水与地下引水渠道。较古老的建筑景观包括称作阿尔德比勒的堡垒，传统将它与萨珊王朝的阿努希尔万联系起来，这一说法属于城堡的古代历史记忆。

卡扎尔王朝初期，琼达克在行政上仍与亚兹德相连。法特赫阿里沙1834年统治结束以前的最后十年，这一关系发生变化，当地被划归以塞姆南一带为中心的库米斯。1781年生于附近胡尔的诗人雅格玛·詹达吉，也以这一地区为称号。当地由此既经历省级隶属关系调整，又通过诗人与波斯文学生活发生具体联系，成为十九世纪初沙漠地区历史的两条线索。

english: Jonga Pansa lies in the upper Kasai country of eastern Angola. The Kasai rises on the Bié plateau, flows east across the highlands, then turns north towards the Congo basin. Its headwaters lie near the watershed separating rivers bound for the Congo from those flowing south towards the Zambezi.
simp_chinese: 琼加潘萨位于安哥拉东部的开赛河上游地区。开赛河发源于比耶高原，向东穿过高地，随后转向北方流往刚果盆地。源头靠近分水岭，将流向刚果河的水系与向南流向赞比西河的水系分开。

english:
Jongkong's early story belongs to the Embau country of the upper Kapuas. Local tradition places the first settlement near Lake Unang, where an old grave is associated with Abang Jombo, also called Kiyai Pati Uda. He was remembered as a figure in the spread of Islam among Embau's inhabitants. Accounts also connect the ruling families of Jongkong with those of Suhaid, Silat and Bunut.

The court's palace, known as Susuriyah, stood at Ulak Landau near the later Jongkong Kiri settlement. Oral traditions place the kingdom's beginnings around the late seventeenth or early eighteenth century, although other chronologies give a later foundation. This river polity joined local descent relationships with Islamic authority: its history was preserved through remembered rulers, burial places and the location of the palace. The settlement's story consequently extends beyond downstream trading connections to a political and religious centre within the upper Kapuas itself.
simp_chinese:
戎空较早的故事属于卡普阿斯河上游的恩巴乌地区。地方传统将最初聚落放在乌南湖附近，那里的一座古墓被认为属于阿邦·琼博，亦称基亚伊·帕蒂·乌达。他被记为向恩巴乌居民传播伊斯兰教的人物之一。相关叙述还把戎空王族与苏海德、锡拉特及布努特的统治家族联系起来。

王宫称苏苏里亚宫，位于乌拉克兰道、后来的戎空左岸聚落附近。口述传统把王国的起源置于十七世纪末至十八世纪初，不过另有年表给出更晚的建国时间。这处河流政体将地方血缘关系与伊斯兰权威结合起来；历代人物、墓地与宫址，成为保存其历史记忆的依托。戎空因此不仅联系着下游贸易，也在上卡普阿斯地区形成了自身的政治与宗教中心。

english:
The Jonkershoek Mountains enclosed a valley east of Stellenbosch, where steep slopes restricted grazing and settlement to more accessible ground. Before colonial farms spread through the valley, Khoekhoe herders moved through the wider Stellenbosch country with their livestock. Their seasonal routes and grazing belonged to a landscape later divided into irrigable farm grants.

During the 1680s and 1690s, landholding along the Eerste River included both European settlers and people freed from slavery. Jan Andriessen, known as Jan de Jonker, received the property that gave Jonkershoek its name; the recorded grant was renewed in 1692. Nearby holdings belonged to Manuel and Anthony of Angola, Louis of Bengal, and Marquart and Jan of Ceylon. Vines, grain, sheep and cattle appeared in the farm returns. These records describe the valley beneath the mountains, where irrigation and colonial property boundaries reshaped access to land, while the surrounding heights continued to define the catchment and its limited cultivable space.
simp_chinese:
琼克斯胡克山环抱斯泰伦博斯以东的山谷，陡坡使放牧与定居集中在较易到达的地面。殖民农场扩展之前，科伊科伊人赶着牲畜季节性穿行更广阔的斯泰伦博斯地域；后来，沿途可灌溉的谷地被划为农场。

十七世纪八九十年代，埃尔斯特河沿岸的土地持有者既有欧洲移民，也有获释奴隶。人称扬·德琼克的扬·安德里森获得了为琼克斯胡克命名的地产，1692年授地记录再次确认其产权。邻近地产属于来自安哥拉的曼努埃尔与安东尼、孟加拉的路易，以及锡兰的马夸特和扬。农场登记可见葡萄、谷物、羊与牛。这些记载属于山下谷地：灌溉和殖民产权重塑土地使用，周围高山则限定集水区及可耕空间。

english:
Jonzac grew around two heights above the Seugne valley: the castle on Mont Balaguier and the religious quarter on Mont-Guimard. Houses formed part of the medieval town's defences beside its gates. The earlier castle was destroyed during the Hundred Years' War, and the Sainte-Maure lords rebuilt their stronghold in the fifteenth century. Its twin-towered entrance expressed the defensive role of a lordly centre within war-torn Saintonge.

The castle changed character during the seventeenth century. Léon de Sainte-Maure enlarged it into a more comfortable residence and embellished the courtyard with terracotta decoration. Louis XIV and Mazarin stayed there in 1659, showing the continuing place of this provincial residence in aristocratic and royal travel. Protestant Jonzac had also experienced the Wars of Religion, requiring another period of repair and rebuilding. The castle escaped confiscation during the Revolution. By the early nineteenth century it had passed to Antoine-Charles Tardieu, marquis de Maleissye, who served as mayor from 1810 to 1813.
simp_chinese:
容扎克围绕瑟讷河谷上方的两处高地发展：巴拉吉耶山上的城堡，以及蒙吉马尔山的宗教街区。中世纪房屋参与城门两侧的防御，旧堡在百年战争中毁坏，圣莫尔领主于十五世纪重建；双塔夹持的入口体现了桑通日战乱中领主中心的军事角色。

十七世纪，城堡性质改变。莱昂·德圣莫尔扩建舒适住宅，并以陶塑装饰庭院。1659年，路易十四与马扎然在此停留，反映地方贵族宅邸仍参与王室行旅。信奉新教的容扎克也经历宗教战争，随后再度修缮重建。大革命期间，城堡没有遭到没收；十九世纪初转归马莱西侯爵安托万-夏尔·塔迪厄，他又于1810至1813年担任市长。

english:
Jo'otsuuk, later called Tihosuco, was a Maya centre of Cochuah on the route between Valladolid and Bacalar. Around 1544 Francisco de Montejo the Nephew conquered the district, bringing it into the encomienda system of tribute and service. Franciscans arrived in 1579 and made the town a religious teaching centre for neighbouring communities. By then Indigenous builders had already provided a masonry church.

During the later seventeenth century the town lay along a colonial frontier, with unconquered Maya settlements to the southeast. Its position and prosperity also attracted raiders. In 1686 the privateers Lorencillo and Agramont plundered and burned Tihosuco. By the middle eighteenth century it was the headquarters of Beneficios Altos and an important commercial centre. A historical study records 1,937 inhabitants in 1776 and identifies maize, beans, cotton, honey and livestock among its products. The town's colonial development therefore joined Maya labour and agricultural production to religious institutions, imposed obligations and the risks of a contested overland trading route.
simp_chinese:
霍楚克后来称蒂奥苏科，是瓦拉多利德通往巴卡拉尔路上的科丘阿玛雅中心。约1544年，小弗朗西斯科·德蒙特霍征服当地，将其纳入承担贡赋及劳役的恩贡米恩达体系。1579年方济各会士到来，设为周围社群的宗教教学中心；当地原住民此前已建成石灰砂浆砌筑的教堂。

十七世纪后期，城镇位于殖民边疆，东南仍有未被征服的玛雅聚落。位置和财富也吸引袭掠者，1686年私掠者洛伦西略与阿格拉蒙特洗劫并烧毁蒂奥苏科。十八世纪中期，它成为Beneficios Altos辖区治所及重要商业中心。历史研究记载1776年人口一千九百三十七，生产玉米、豆、棉花、蜂蜜并饲养牲畜。原住民劳动与农业、宗教机构、强制义务及争夺中的陆路贸易，在此紧密交织。

english:
Joroinen developed as an independent parish in the lake country of Savo around 1630. Its first recorded parish priest, Marcus Aeschilli, held office from 1631. The new parish brought together several tithe districts, including communities associated with Joroinen itself and neighbouring Pieksämäki and Sääminki. Its second church was built in 1685.

Church administration left a growing documentary record of the locality. Parish accounts survive from 1694, registers of births, marriages and deaths from 1695, and communion books from 1725. These records followed households and religious life across the countryside. Eighteenth-century decisions also addressed the duties and support of parish personnel: a district court ruling of 1761 concerned labour obligations, while a parish meeting in 1796 considered the schoolteacher's remuneration. The parish consequently served as a durable local institution linking scattered settlements through worship, record keeping and the provision of teaching.
simp_chinese:
约罗伊宁位于萨沃湖区，约1630年成为独立教区。首位有记录的主任牧师马库斯·埃斯基利，于1631年开始任职。新教区联合了约罗伊宁本地，以及与皮耶克赛迈基、塞明基相联系的若干什一税区，1685年兴建第二座教堂。

教会管理也留下逐渐增多的地方记录：账簿自1694年起保存，出生、婚姻和死亡登记始于1695年，圣餐名册始于1725年。这些文书记录乡间家庭与宗教生活。十八世纪还有涉及人员供养和义务的决定：1761年地区法院处理劳役问题，1796年教区会议讨论教师待遇。教区由此成为连接分散聚落的持久机构，兼有礼拜、登记与教学职能。

english:
Jororo names a community and a wider group of Indigenous settlements in the upper Kissimmee watershed of central Florida. These were loosely connected communities whose subsistence did not depend on agriculture. Lakeside and island settlements supported fishing, hunting and gathering roots, nuts and fruits. Spanish records named Jororo, Atissimi and Atoyquime among the larger communities of the region.

Franciscan missionaries established San Joseph de Jororo and La Concepción de Atoyquime around 1692. Their presence brought a brief and contested extension of Spanish religious authority into the lake country. A royal mission list compiled in 1697 reported no resident friar at Jororo after a revolt involving the deaths of a religious, a Spaniard and Indigenous people. It also described Tissimi and Atuiquimi as in revolt. These records document an unstable mission frontier, rather than the settled conversion of a unified province; local communities continued to shape whether outsiders could remain among them.
simp_chinese:
霍罗罗既是一处社群名称，也指佛罗里达中部基西米河上游流域较广的一组原住民聚落。这些联系较为松散的社群，其生计不以农业为基础。湖岸与岛上聚落依靠捕鱼、狩猎，以及采集根茎、坚果和水果生活。西班牙记录列出霍罗罗、阿蒂西米与阿托伊基梅等较大的社群。

方济各会传教士约于1692年设立圣约瑟夫·德·霍罗罗和圣母无染原罪·德·阿托伊基梅传教站，将西班牙宗教权力短暂且充满争议地伸入湖区。1697年王家官员编制的传教站名录记载，一场涉及修士、西班牙人及原住民死亡的起义后，霍罗罗没有驻地修士；名录也称蒂西米与阿图伊基米处于反抗之中。这些资料显示的是不稳定的传教边疆，并不能证明整个统一行省已经皈依；当地社群仍影响外来者能否驻留。

sources.title: CR19A Phase I Cultural Resource Assessment Survey.pdf

english:
Jorquera occupies a defensible height between the Júcar and the Abengibre valley. Its upper walls preserve an Almohad stronghold, but later rulers continued to reshape the defences. In the fifteenth century a lower enclosure was added, with two gateways protected by towers; the Torre de Doña Blanca survives from this system.

The town became the administrative centre of the seigneurial State of Jorquera under the marquises of Villena. A lord-appointed chief magistrate resided here and exercised authority over its dependent settlements. The practical importance of residence appears in an order preserved in the Spanish nobility archives: the marquis required Jorquera's local magistrates to live in the places where they served. Walls, offices and written commands together sustained the town's role as a centre of jurisdiction in the Júcar country.
simp_chinese:
霍尔克拉占据胡卡尔河与阿本希夫雷谷地之间易于防守的高地。上部城墙保留了穆瓦希德王朝的堡垒，但后来的统治者仍继续改造防御设施。15世纪增筑下层围墙，设置两处由塔楼守护的城门，唐娜·布兰卡塔留存于这一体系之中。

在比列纳侯爵统治下，城镇成为霍尔克拉领地的行政中心，领主任命的高级地方官驻于此地，管辖所属聚落。西班牙贵族档案保存的一道命令，显示驻地问题的实际意义：侯爵要求当地官员居住在其任职地点。城墙、官署与书面命令共同维持着城镇在胡卡尔地区的司法行政地位。

english: The high country around Jos is part of a plateau of hills and river valleys, home to Berom, Anaguta and Afizere communities. Its streams carried deposits of tin, which local miners and smiths worked long before the great mines of a later age. The metal could be made into ornaments, and by the eighteenth century tin from the region reached trading posts on the West African coast. The plateau's settlements belonged to a varied landscape of peoples and languages, distinct from the surrounding plains.
simp_chinese: 乔斯周围的高地属于一片山丘与河谷交错的高原，贝罗姆、阿纳古塔和阿菲泽雷等社群居于其间。溪流带来锡矿砂，在后来大规模采矿兴起之前，当地矿工和工匠便已开采、加工锡，用它制作饰物。到十八世纪，这一地区的锡已抵达西非海岸的贸易站。高原上的聚落由众多语言和族群组成，与周围平原自成一片不同的世界。

english: José Calçado lies in the uplands of southern Espírito Santo, near the Serra do Jaspe. The Calçado River rises from streams in this hilly country and flows toward the Itabapoana, a river reaching the Atlantic coast. Its rocky banks gave the river and the later settlement their name, recalling a paved surface. Forested hills and narrow watercourses distinguish this inland landscape from the lowlands nearer the sea.
simp_chinese: 若泽卡尔萨多位于圣埃斯皮里图南部高地，靠近雅斯皮山脉。卡尔萨多河由山地溪流汇成，流向通往大西洋海岸的伊塔巴波阿纳河。多石的河岸让人联想到铺筑的路面，也赋予河流和后来聚落以名称。森林覆盖的丘陵与狭窄水道，使这片内陆景观有别于靠海的低地。

english:
Joseph Bonaparte Gulf lies off the northern Australian coast between Western Australia and the Northern Territory. Its present European name comes from Nicolas Baudin's expedition in 1803, honoring Napoleon's brother Joseph. The naming belongs to the expedition's survey of Australia's coasts; it does not date the beginning of human knowledge or use of the gulf.

A published chronology of the voyage records Baudin reaching the gulf on 23 June 1803. His ships had sailed north from Timor earlier that month, but illness, exhaustion and diminishing water supplies prevented the intended continuation toward Torres Strait. Baudin decided to return to Île de France, now Mauritius, where he died in September. The gulf thus marked a turning point at the end of the voyage. This episode gives its charted name a precise historical context, shaped by the limits of the crews and their provisions as well as the ambitions of maritime exploration.
simp_chinese:
约瑟夫·波拿巴湾位于澳大利亚北岸，介于西澳大利亚与北领地之间。今天使用的欧洲名称来自1803年尼古拉·博丹的考察航行，用以纪念拿破仑的兄长约瑟夫。这一命名属于欧洲海岸测绘活动，不能作为当地海域开始为人知晓或使用的年代。

出版的航行年表记载，博丹于1803年6月23日抵达海湾。船队此前从帝汶向北出发，但疾病、疲劳和饮水不足，使原定继续驶往托雷斯海峡的计划无法完成。博丹决定返航法兰西岛，即今毛里求斯，并于同年9月在那里去世。海湾因此成为这次远航末期的转折点。这个具体事件也说明地图上名称形成的背景：测绘的目标受船员健康、体力和补给条件共同制约。

english:
Jösse was a district of western Värmland, comprising parishes around Arvika and the border with Norway. Its name refers to a rural jurisdiction rather than a single medieval town. Parish communities including Eda, Köla, Gunnarskog and Älgå belonged to this regional landscape, where local affairs were brought before the district court.

The court's archival history records repeated reorganisations of higher judicial administration. In 1680 Jösse belonged to the larger Västersysslet circuit together with several other Värmland districts. In 1779 it was grouped with Grums and Nordmark in a separate circuit. That arrangement ended in 1830, when Jösse was combined with Lower Fryksdal under the Västersysslet name. Through these changes, the district's parishes came under successive arrangements for the administration of justice.
simp_chinese:
约瑟是韦姆兰西部、阿尔维卡及挪威边界周围的一个地区。其名称指乡村司法辖区，并非一座中世纪城镇。埃达、雪拉、贡纳斯库格及埃尔亚等教区社群属于这一地区，地方事务在区法院处理。

法院档案介绍记载了上级司法组织多次调整。1680年，约瑟与韦姆兰其他数区同属较大的西叙斯莱特司法巡回区。1779年，它与格鲁姆斯、努德马克组成独立巡回区。1830年，这一安排结束，约瑟同下弗吕克斯达尔合并，再使用西叙斯莱特之名。随着这些调整，该区各教区先后归入不同的司法组织。

english:
Josselin stands above the River Oust in the heart of Brittany, dominated by the castle of the Rohan family. Great towers face the river, while an elaborately carved residence looks into the courtyard. Jean II de Rohan built the surviving residence between 1495 and 1506, incorporating older towers and turning the fortress into a house worthy of his family's rank.

The Rohans' Protestant faith and opposition to royal policy brought their strongholds under pressure in the seventeenth century. In 1629 the great medieval keep at Josselin was demolished on royal orders, although the Renaissance residence and the three river-facing towers survived the demolition. The castle's remaining buildings preserve the contrast between its medieval defensive strength and the refined architecture of the Rohan court.
simp_chinese:
若瑟兰坐落在布列塔尼腹地的乌斯特河上方，罗昂家族的城堡俯瞰城镇。巨塔面向河流，雕饰精美的住宅则朝向庭院。让二世·德罗昂于1495至1506年间建造现存宅邸，将旧塔纳入其中，使堡垒成为符合家族地位的住宅。

十七世纪，罗昂家族的新教信仰及对王室政策的反对使其据点承受压力。1629年，若瑟兰的巨大主塔奉王命拆毁，文艺复兴宅邸与三座临河塔楼却在拆毁中得以保存。留下的建筑呈现出中世纪防御力量与罗昂宫廷精致建筑之间的鲜明对照。

english: Jotunheimen is a high mountain country between Sogn, Valdres and Gudbrandsdalen, with glaciers and deep lakes. At Gjende and Russvatnet, traces of ancient dwellings accompany reindeer pits and hunting hides. Cairns mark an old route across Sognefjellet between Lom and Luster. In the early eighteenth century, farms in Bøverdalen sent cattle to summer pastures at Gjendebu, taking them through the Visdalen, Urdadalen and Storådalen valleys.
simp_chinese: 尤通黑门是松恩、瓦尔德雷斯与古德布兰兹达伦之间的高山地带，有冰川和深湖。延德湖与鲁斯湖附近的古居所遗迹，与捕鹿陷坑和狩猎掩体一同留存。石堆标示着翻越松恩山地、连接洛姆和吕斯特的古道。十八世纪初，伯弗达伦的农场把牛群送往延德布夏牧场，途中穿过维斯谷、乌尔达谷和斯图罗谷。

english:
Jōtō lay east of the Asahi River in Bizen, across the water from the castle town of Okayama. Its low fields repeatedly suffered when the river's left bank failed. Protecting the castle town could also increase the burden on the district: a flood-diversion scheme directed excess water southeastward across Jōtō's farmland.

The destructive flood of 1654 prompted proposals associated with Kumazawa Banzan. Tsuda Nagatada advanced the plan in 1669, and an overflow embankment was constructed in 1670. Its relief of Okayama came at a heavy cost to the fields receiving the water. Later works sought to combine flood control with land reclamation. In 1686–1687 the Hyakken River channel was developed further, and in 1692 it was carried through to Kojima Bay alongside the Okinitta reclamation. A detention basin and sluices at the mouth helped discharge water and prevent the tide from flowing back. Jōtō's fields thus became central to the domain's hydraulic engineering.
simp_chinese:
备前上道位于旭川以东，与冈山城下隔水相望。左岸堤防决口时，低地田亩反复受灾。保护城下也可能加重上道的负担：分洪方案把过量河水引向东南，流经当地农田。

1654年的大洪水促成熊泽蕃山相关治水构想。津田永忠在1669年推进方案，次年修筑溢流堤；冈山灾情减轻，承受洪水的上道田地却损失严重。后续工程尝试兼顾分洪与新田开发。1686至1687年，百间川进一步开筑；1692年配合冲新田开发，河道贯通至儿岛湾，并在河口设置滞洪水域与排水闸门，以排出内水、阻止潮水倒灌。上道农田由此成为冈山藩水利工程的重要场域。

english: Jowhar lies on the floodplain of the Shebelle River in southern Somalia. The river descends from the Ethiopian highlands and winds across the Somali lowlands, bringing water to a region surrounded by much drier country. Its seasonal floods have helped sustain cultivation and settlements along the valley.
simp_chinese: 乔哈尔位于索马里南部谢贝利河泛滥平原。河流从埃塞俄比亚高地蜿蜒流过索马里低地，为周围干燥的土地带来水源。季节性洪水有助于维系河谷沿线的耕作与聚落。

english:
The open waters around Juan Fernández lay roughly 700 kilometres off central Chile. The volcanic islands offered rare places to replenish supplies during voyages across the southeastern Pacific. The Valparaíso natural history museum dates the Spanish navigator Juan Fernández's arrival to 1574 and describes the archipelago's subsequent use as an occasional refuge and provisioning stop for navigators, pirates and privateers.

Ships could obtain water and vegetables after rounding Cape Horn or passing through the Strait of Magellan, or between operations along the Chilean and Peruvian coasts. This use encouraged the Spanish crown to attempt a more permanent presence. In 1749 it sent 62 soldiers and 171 colonists, while fortifications and batteries were intended to control strategic anchorages. These island events provide context for the surrounding sea route; they do not imply that the open ocean itself was occupied or that the first colonial settlement immediately became secure.
simp_chinese:
胡安·费尔南德斯群岛周边远海距智利中部海岸约700公里。火山岛为东南太平洋航行提供了少见的补给地点。瓦尔帕莱索自然史博物馆将西班牙航海者胡安·费尔南德斯抵达群岛的时间记为1574年，并介绍其后航海者、海盗和私掠者将这里用作间歇避难及补给站。

船只绕过合恩角或穿行麦哲伦海峡后，或在智利、秘鲁海岸活动之间，可以在岛上补充淡水和蔬菜。此类利用促使西班牙王室尝试建立更稳定的据点。1749年，西班牙派来62名士兵和171名移民，并计划用堡垒及炮台控制战略锚地。这些岛上事件说明周边航路的背景，不能视作对远海本身的占领，也不意味着最初殖民聚落立刻稳固下来。

english: The Juan Fernández Islands rise from the Pacific far west of Chile, their steep volcanic slopes separated by open sea. Spanish navigator Juan Fernández reached the eastern islands in 1574 while exploring a route away from the adverse winds and current along the mainland coast. The archipelago later served passing sailors as a source of water and food. Its isolation also allowed plants and animals to develop distinctive forms found nowhere else.
simp_chinese: 胡安·费尔南德斯群岛从智利以西遥远的太平洋中升起，陡峭的火山坡地被开阔海域分隔。1574年，西班牙航海家胡安·费尔南德斯探索远离大陆沿岸逆风与逆流的航线时，抵达东部岛屿。群岛后来为过往船员提供淡水和食物。与世隔绝的环境也使动植物演化出其他地方没有的独特类型。

english:
The ocean west of Chile around Juan Fernández offered mariners a refuge far from the mainland's Spanish ports. Juan Fernández's voyage of 1574 brought the islands into European navigation, and their fresh water, timber and goats later made them attractive to ships crossing the eastern Pacific. The surrounding high seas linked these anchorages with raids and trading voyages along the coasts of Chile and Peru.

English privateers repeatedly entered this maritime world. Alexander Selkirk remained on Más a Tierra from 1704 until his rescue in 1709, surviving through hunting, fishing and a small garden before rejoining a privateering expedition. George Anson's voyage of 1740–1744 likewise used the archipelago during operations against Spanish commerce. Such visits encouraged Spanish officials to secure an anchorage that rivals could otherwise use for repairs and supplies. A permanent settlement was established in 1750, followed by fortification and a penal role. By the early nineteenth century, voyages through these waters could carry soldiers, prisoners and provisions as well as visiting sailors. The islands' remoteness made control costly, but the same distance increased their value as an offshore stopping place.
simp_chinese:
智利以西胡安·费尔南德斯附近的远海，为水手提供远离大陆西班牙港口的避泊选择。胡安·费尔南德斯1574年的航行将群岛纳入欧洲航海视野，淡水、木材和山羊随后吸引横渡东太平洋的船只。周围海域将这些锚地接向智利、秘鲁沿岸的袭击与贸易航程。

英国私掠者屡次进入这里。亚历山大·塞尔柯克自1704年留在马斯阿蒂埃拉岛，靠狩猎、捕鱼和小园地生存，至1709年获救，重新加入私掠远征。乔治·安森1740—1744年的航行，也在袭击西班牙商业航线时利用群岛。外来船只修理、补给的机会，促使西班牙官员加强对锚地的控制。1750年常设定居点建立，随后增筑防御并承担流放功能。十九世纪初，驶过这些水域的船只既运送来访水手，也载着士兵、囚犯和给养。远隔大陆使统治成本高昂，同时也提升了群岛作为外海停驻点的价值。

english:
These offshore waters surround the Juan Fernández group west of Chile. The islands offered rare stopping places along the long Pacific passages between the southern tip of South America and the ports of Chile and Peru. Juan Fernández encountered the archipelago in 1574 while sailing south from Callao toward Valparaíso on an offshore course that avoided the northward Humboldt Current. The discovery brought a remote source of water and provisions into European knowledge of the eastern Pacific.

The islands subsequently served visiting navigators, privateers and pirates after the arduous southern passage into the ocean. Water, fresh vegetables and an opportunity to recover from fatigue or scurvy could determine whether a voyage continued. Alexander Selkirk went ashore on Más a Tierra in 1704 and lived there alone until he was rescued more than four years later. The ocean zone shared the archipelago's broader history of passage and occasional refuge. Ships approaching land moved between the uncertainty of a long ocean crossing and a small number of places where crews could obtain essential supplies.
simp_chinese:
这片远海环绕智利以西的胡安·费尔南德斯群岛。在南美洲南端与智利、秘鲁港口之间的漫长太平洋航程中，群岛提供了少见的停歇地点。1574年，胡安·费尔南德斯由卡亚俄向瓦尔帕莱索南航，采用远离海岸的路线，避开向北流动的洪堡洋流，并发现群岛。这使东太平洋欧洲航海知识中增加了一处偏远的淡水和补给来源。

此后，航海者、私掠者与海盗在艰难穿越南方海峡或合恩角以后，利用岛屿停歇。饮水、新鲜蔬菜，以及从疲惫或坏血病中恢复的机会，都可能影响航程能否继续。亚历山大·塞尔柯克于1704年在马斯阿蒂埃拉岛上岸，此后独自在岛上生活，四年多后才获救。这片海域分享的是群岛外围的通航与间歇避难历史，来船在漫长渡海的不确定性与少数可获得必需补给的登陆点之间往返。

english: The open Pacific west of Chile leads toward the Juan Fernández Islands, far from the mainland coast. In 1574 the Spanish pilot Juan Fernández sailed west from the usual coastal route to escape the northward Humboldt Current, then turned south toward Chile. On that voyage he sighted islands that came to bear his name. His route made the difficult southward passage from Callao considerably faster and was adopted by later sailors.
simp_chinese: 智利以西的太平洋外海通向远离大陆的胡安·费尔南德斯群岛。1574年，西班牙领航员胡安·费尔南德斯离开通常的沿岸航线向西航行，以避开向北流动的洪堡寒流，再转向南方驶往智利。途中他望见后来以其名字命名的岛屿。这条航路大大加快了从卡亚俄艰难南下的航程，后来为其他水手采用。

english:
The Juan Fernández offshore Pacific formed part of the ocean approaches to Chile, several hundred kilometres from the mainland. Its history is tied to ships reaching the archipelago after rounding South America and to the rivalry over access to its anchorages. In 1741 George Anson's expedition arrived after storms around Cape Horn had scattered his squadron and the Wager had been wrecked off Patagonia. Anson postponed an intended attack on Valdivia and sought Juan Fernández so that his surviving ships could be repaired and their crews recover.

Such visits showed Spanish officials the strategic consequences of leaving offshore stopping places available to enemies. A plan for permanent occupation in 1750 included Robinson Crusoe Island, then known as Más a Tierra, alongside a separate project in the Chonos archipelago. These were attempts to secure specific islands and harbours, not to settle the open sea. Toward the end of the eighteenth century whaling vessels also visited Juan Fernández, and early nineteenth-century sealing drew on its fur-seal colonies. Naval recovery, imperial defence and commercial hunting thus gave successive purposes to voyages across the same remote waters.
simp_chinese:
胡安·费尔南德斯远海是通往智利的太平洋航行地带，距南美大陆数百公里。其历史同绕过南美洲、驶向群岛的船舶，以及围绕锚地使用展开的竞争相联系。1741年，乔治·安森的远征船队在合恩角附近遭风暴打散，韦杰号又在巴塔哥尼亚外海失事。安森因而推迟进攻瓦尔迪维亚的计划，转向胡安·费尔南德斯修理幸存船只，让船员恢复体力。

这类停靠向西班牙官员显示，离岸补给地被敌国利用会产生实际战略后果。1750年的永久占领计划包括当时称马斯阿蒂埃拉的鲁滨孙岛，并另有乔诺斯群岛的设点项目。这些措施针对具体岛屿与港湾，不能理解为远洋中的定居扩展。十八世纪末，捕鲸船也开始到访；十九世纪初，猎捕海豹的船只又利用岛屿的毛皮海豹群。舰队休整、帝国防御与商业捕猎，使同一片偏远海域的航行先后承担了不同目的。

english: Far out in the southeastern Pacific, the Juan Fernández archipelago rises from the ocean west of Chile. Its western island, historically called Más Afuera, lies well beyond the island of Más a Tierra and has fewer sheltered anchorages. The Humboldt Current flows between the islands and the mainland, separating the oceanic island waters from the cold current along the coast. Sailors who reached this remote group encountered a landscape of steep volcanic islands surrounded by open sea.
simp_chinese: 在东南太平洋远海，胡安·费尔南德斯群岛从智利以西的海洋中升起。群岛西侧的岛屿旧称“更远岛”，位于“近地岛”以西很远处，避风锚地较少。洪堡寒流在群岛与大陆之间流动，将岛屿周围的远洋水域与沿岸冷流分隔开来。抵达这片偏远群岛的水手面对的是被开阔大海包围的陡峭火山岛。

english: The seas around the Juan Fernández Islands offered a distant refuge to ships that had rounded South America and entered the Pacific. Crews could seek fresh water and provisions on the islands before continuing along the Spanish American coast. In 1704 the Scottish sailor Alexander Selkirk was put ashore on Más a Tierra after a dispute with his captain. He remained there alone for more than four years before a passing expedition rescued him in 1709.
simp_chinese: 胡安·费尔南德斯群岛周围的海域，为绕过南美洲进入太平洋的船只提供了一处遥远的避泊地。船员可在岛上寻找淡水和补给，再沿西属美洲海岸继续航行。1704年，苏格兰水手亚历山大·塞尔柯克与船长发生争执后，被留在近地岛。他独自在岛上生活四年多，直到1709年被经过的探险队救走。

english:
The Juan Fernández Islands became known to European navigation in the sixteenth century, with 22 November 1574 accepted as the conventional date of Juan Fernández's encounter. Their isolated position off Chile made them a refuge for privateers during the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries. In 1704 Alexander Selkirk went ashore on Más a Tierra, remaining there for more than four years before being rescued in 1709.

Spanish authorities sought to prevent foreign ships from making use of this refuge. A royal order of 7 May 1749 directed that the island be settled and defended. In March 1750 a ship sailed from Concepción carrying soldiers, settlers and prisoners assigned to fortification work. Construction began on the settlement and the Santa Bárbara defences, but the sea destroyed the works on 25 May 1751 and rebuilding became necessary. Even after settlement, dependence on provisions from the mainland made hunger a recurrent danger. The islands' strategic value was therefore accompanied by the persistent difficulty of sustaining an isolated garrison and community.
simp_chinese:
胡安·费尔南德斯群岛于十六世纪进入欧洲航海记录，胡安·费尔南德斯到达这里的通行纪念日期为1574年11月22日。群岛远离智利海岸的地理位置，使其在十七至十八世纪成为私掠船的避难地。1704年，亚历山大·塞尔柯克在马斯阿蒂埃拉岛上岸，独居四年多，于1709年获救。

西班牙当局试图阻止外国船只利用这一庇护所。1749年5月7日王令要求在岛上定居并设防；1750年3月，一艘船自康塞普西翁出航，载来军人、移民及承担筑防劳动的囚犯。聚落与圣巴尔瓦拉防御工事开始营建，却在1751年5月25日遭海水摧毁，必须重新修建。即使定居之后，岛民仍依赖大陆运来的粮食，饥饿反复威胁军人与居民。群岛拥有战略价值，维持孤立驻军和社群的困难也始终相随。

english:
Juancheng was the seat of Puzhou in the Yellow River plain of southwestern Shandong. The medieval county and the prefectural administration occupied the same place, but they were separate levels of government. In 1369, early in the Ming dynasty, Juancheng County was abolished and its territory incorporated directly into Puzhou. Puzhou in turn belonged to Dongchang Prefecture.

The change removed the county office beneath the prefectural seat while retaining the larger jurisdiction. Puzhou administered Fan, Guancheng and Chaocheng counties as well as its directly governed territory. Juancheng’s early Ming history therefore belongs to a specific administrative reorganisation of the river plain. The old name survived beyond the county’s abolition, even as the local government operated through Puzhou rather than a separate Juancheng magistracy.
simp_chinese:
鄄城曾是山东西南黄河平原上濮州的治所。中世纪的鄄城县与濮州州署同处一地，但属于不同层级的行政机关。明朝初年，1369年撤销鄄城县，将其辖境直接并入濮州；濮州则隶属东昌府。

这次调整撤去了州治所在地的附郭县，同时保留濮州这一较大的行政辖区。除直属地区外，濮州还管辖范县、观城和朝城。鄄城在明初的历史由此与黄河平原上一项具体的行政重组相连。县被撤销后，旧地名仍然留存，当地治理则通过濮州进行，不再另设鄄城县衙。

english:
Juban, in Yemen's southern highlands, was one of the home centres of the Banu Tahir, whose family also held al-Miqranah. The Tahirids rose through service to the Rasulid sultans, turning the disorders of that dynasty's final decades to their advantage. In 1454 the brothers Amir and Ali took Aden and established a sultanate that controlled much of southern Yemen. Its rulers spent summers at Juban and al-Miqranah, returning to lowland Zabid in winter.

Royal residence brought architectural patronage to the highland town. Mosques and religious foundations formed part of a wider Tahirid programme that also provided cisterns, channels and bridges. Outside Juban stood the family's stone-built tomb, its four domes covering wooden sarcophagi; Ali al-Malik al-Mujahid was buried there after his death in the town in 1478. The dynasty's power collapsed before a Mamluk advance in 1517, although Tahirid resistance survived elsewhere until the Ottoman seizure of Aden in 1538. Juban's mosques and royal burials preserved the memory of a town closely involved in the government and religious life of late medieval Yemen.
simp_chinese:
朱班位于也门南部高地，与附近的米格拉纳同为塔希尔家族的故乡与权力中心。塔希尔家族原为拉苏尔苏丹效力，利用王朝末年的纷争逐渐崛起。1454年，阿米尔与阿里兄弟夺取亚丁，建立统治也门南部大片地区的苏丹国。统治者夏居朱班和米格拉纳，冬季返回低地的扎比德。

王室驻居为高地城镇带来建筑营造。清真寺和宗教设施属于塔希尔王朝的建设事业，同类工程还包括蓄水池、水渠与桥梁。朱班城外的王族陵墓以石材砌成，四座穹顶下安置木制棺椁；阿里·穆贾希德于1478年在城中去世后葬于此地。1517年，马穆鲁克军队的进攻摧毁了王朝的主要权力，其他地方的塔希尔势力仍坚持抵抗，直到1538年奥斯曼夺取亚丁。朱班的清真寺与王族墓葬，留下了这座城镇深度参与中世纪晚期也门政务与宗教生活的痕迹。

english: Jubara lies near Shakh Shakh in the dry country northeast of the Aral Sea. Here the Bostobe Formation exposes alternating red clays and sandstones, preserving the remains of animals that lived in the Late Cretaceous. Fossil teeth from the beds include those of several groups of dinosaurs, while other finds reveal mammals that inhabited the same ancient landscape.
simp_chinese: 朱巴拉位于咸海东北方的干旱地带，靠近沙赫沙赫。这里出露的博斯托别地层由红色黏土和砂岩交替组成，保存着晚白垩世动物的遗骸。岩层出土的化石牙齿属于数类恐龙，其他发现则揭示了生活在同一远古环境中的哺乳动物。

english:
Jubbah is an oasis in the great Nafud sand desert, north of Ha'il. Its water and cultivated ground stand amid shifting dunes, while the nearby mountain of Umm Sinman preserves a remarkable record of earlier inhabitants. Its rock faces once overlooked a freshwater lake, long since vanished. People carved figures and inscriptions into the stone over many centuries, leaving images of animals, hunters and riders in a landscape transformed by aridity.

The carvings belong to several periods. Some of the oldest depict long-horned cattle and human figures, recalling a time when the land around the lake supported a different range of animals. Later images include camels and horses, hunting scenes and weapons, while inscriptions were cut into the rock alongside them. Jubbah also served as a stopping place for caravans travelling through northern Arabia, where its oasis offered a welcome source of water among the sands.
simp_chinese:
朱拜是哈伊勒以北大内夫得沙漠中的一处绿洲。水源和耕地坐落在流动沙丘之间，附近的乌姆辛曼山则保存着先民留下的珍贵记录。山岩曾俯瞰一座淡水湖，湖泊早已消失。历经许多世纪，人们在岩面刻下人物、铭文、动物、猎手和骑者，为后来变得干旱的土地留下见证。

这些刻画属于不同时期。最古老的部分描绘长角牛和人形，令人想起湖畔曾经生活着不同动物的年代。后来的图像包括骆驼、马、狩猎场景和武器，岩面上还刻有铭文。朱拜也曾是穿越阿拉伯北部的商队停驻之地，绿洲为沙海中的旅人提供了宝贵水源。

english: Hudson Strait links the Atlantic with the immense inland waters of Hudson Bay. Ice forms in the strait and can also drift into it from neighbouring seas, making the passage a difficult one even in the warmer months. In 1610 Henry Hudson sailed through these waters aboard the Discovery while seeking a route to Asia; after spending the winter in the bay, his expedition ended in mutiny.
simp_chinese: 哈得孙海峡连接大西洋与广阔的哈得孙湾。海峡自身会结冰，邻近海域的浮冰也会漂入，使航行即使在较温暖的季节仍然困难。1610年，亨利·哈得孙乘“发现号”经过这里，寻找通往亚洲的航路；船队在湾中过冬后，他的探险以船员哗变告终。

english: Jubururu lies near Dambarling, the salt lake also known as Lake Dumbleyung, in Noongar country. The lake occupies a broad shallow basin, and its salty waters attract many kinds of waterbird. Rock holes known as gnamma occur in the surrounding district and hold precious water in the dry country. Noongar knowledge of Dambarling includes its birds, water places and the game of dumbung, played with a stick and a hard object.
simp_chinese: 朱布鲁鲁位于努恩加人的丹巴林湖附近，这座盐湖也称丹布尔雍湖。湖水占据一片宽阔浅盆地，咸水吸引多种水鸟。周围地区有称为格纳马的岩穴，在干旱地带保存宝贵的水。努恩加人对丹巴林的知识涵盖当地水鸟、水源，以及用棍棒和硬物玩的丹邦游戏。

english:
The town now called Jucás developed as São Mateus in Ceará's Jaguaribe valley. The municipal historical account places its early settlement near the river's left bank, in an area inhabited by Quixelô people. Settlers arriving from the São Francisco basin and neighboring northeastern captaincies sought land along the Jaguaribe and its tributaries. The history of the town consequently belongs to a river valley already occupied before colonial settlement expanded into it.

A documented step in the formation of São Mateus came on 4 September 1731, when Cosmo Ferreira da Silva donated land for a chapel. The church became the focus of an emerging parish, separated from Icó on 7 December 1755. Its construction proceeded in stages, beginning with the chancel and sacristy before the main body and later additions. São Mateus was raised to town status in 1823. These dates trace the settlement's progression from a chapel foundation to an ecclesiastical and municipal center before the end of the colonial and early imperial period.
simp_chinese:
今天的朱卡斯在塞阿拉州雅瓜里贝河谷发展起来，早期名为圣马特乌斯。市政府的地方史将聚落起点置于河流左岸附近，那里原有基舍洛人居住。来自圣弗朗西斯科河流域及东北邻近地区的殖民移民，沿雅瓜里贝河及支流寻找土地；城镇的形成发生在一个早已有原住民生活的河谷中。

1731年9月4日，科斯莫·费雷拉·达席尔瓦捐出土地兴建小教堂，为聚落发展留下明确记录。1755年12月7日，当地堂区从伊科划出。教堂分阶段营建，先建圣坛和祭衣间，再扩建主体及其他部分。1823年，圣马特乌斯取得城镇地位。从教堂捐地、堂区独立到地方建制的建立，这些节点勾勒出它在十八世纪至十九世纪初逐步成为地区中心的过程。

english:
Juchatengo belonged to the Chatino country of southern Oaxaca, where neighbouring communities and hereditary lords defended claims through both local knowledge and colonial legal procedures. Maps and paintings could carry evidence about territory and descent. They were therefore more than illustrations: their figures and written signs entered arguments over the rights of a cacicazgo, a hereditary indigenous lordship.

In 1717 Juchatengo and Ixtapan supplied such figures and lettering for maps and paintings presented in the proceedings concerning the cacicazgo of Don Agustín Carlos Pimentel. Both settlements are identified as Chatino in the historical account. The episode places Juchatengo within a network of communities capable of contributing knowledge and documentary material to a lordship's legal affairs. Its people appear here through their participation in the production of evidence, as local traditions and ways of representing the land encountered the requirements of colonial litigation.
simp_chinese:
胡查滕戈属于瓦哈卡南部的查蒂诺地域。相邻社群与世袭领主维护权利时，既运用地方知识，也参与殖民时期的法律程序。地图和绘画能够呈现土地与世系，因此不仅是图像，还可成为原住民世袭领地权利争讼的材料。

1717年，胡查滕戈与伊斯塔潘为唐阿古斯丁·卡洛斯·皮门特尔世袭领地诉讼所提交的地图、绘画提供“图形与文字”。历史研究将这两个聚落均认作查蒂诺社群。此事使胡查滕戈显现为参与领地法律事务、提供知识与文书材料的地方社群。居民在证据制作中的作用，也显示地方记忆及土地表述方式，如何与殖民司法所需的证明相遇。

english:
Jukkasjärvi grew at an old Sámi church and market meeting place beside the Torne River. Its first church was built in 1607–1608. The present timber building incorporates parts of that earlier structure, but its surviving form largely belongs to the rebuilding of 1726, when the chancel and entrance porch were added. The church's block-pillar construction uses timber buttresses to support its long walls.

Religious gatherings required more than a church alone. An archaeological record identifies the surrounding church-town area, where numerous small church cabins once stood and traces survived near the bell tower. These buildings served the meeting place used by people travelling in from a wider district. Eighteenth-century alterations continued to reshape the church itself: the exterior received boarding in 1747, and major work in 1783–1785 renewed the interior and added a gallery. Its accumulated structure records successive investments in a northern gathering place across nearly two centuries.
simp_chinese:
尤卡斯耶尔维形成于托尔讷河畔一处古老的萨米教堂与市场集会地点。第一座教堂建于1607至1608年。现存木结构教堂保留了早期建筑的一部分，但主要面貌来自1726年的重建，当时增建了圣坛及入口门廊。它采用木构支柱式结构，以木制扶壁支撑两侧长墙。

宗教集会所需的设施并不限于教堂。考古登记划出了周围的教堂镇范围，那里曾有许多供集会使用的小屋，钟楼附近还留有痕迹。这些建筑服务于从更广大地区赶来的人群。十八世纪，教堂仍不断改建：1747年外墙加覆木板，1783至1785年的大型整修更新了内部陈设，并增设楼座。如今叠合的结构，保存了近两个世纪中人们对这处北方集会地点的持续营建。

english: Jucuru lies at the mouth of the Jucuruçu River on the southern coast of Bahia, at the site later known as Prado. Local history traces the settlement to an Aimoré village on the river's left bank, named after the watercourse. The river reaches the Atlantic through a coastal plain between forested land and sandy shores. Its Indigenous name has been explained as combining words for a serpent and great size.
simp_chinese: 茹库鲁位于巴伊亚南岸茹库鲁苏河口，即后来称为普拉多的地方。地方史将聚落起源追溯至河流左岸的一座艾莫雷村庄，村名取自河名。河流穿过森林与沙岸之间的沿海平原，注入大西洋。其原住民名称被解释为“蛇”与“大”两个词的组合。

english:
Judenburg grew near Eppenstein Castle on routes through the upper Mur valley. A market called Judinburch appears in a charter of 1074, when Jewish merchants played an important part in Alpine trade. The town received its charter in 1224 and became a centre of commerce with Venice. Its merchants traded Styrian iron and Alpine valerian, a plant valued for perfume.

In 1460 Frederick III granted Judenburg a monopoly over the valerian trade, which the city retained for more than a century. The Jewish community had a synagogue and ritual bath in its quarter, and a cemetery outside the walls. After pogroms in the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries, Maximilian I ordered the expulsion of Styria's Jews in 1496. The community that had helped shape the town's commerce was forced to leave.
simp_chinese:
尤登堡在上穆尔河谷道路附近的埃彭施泰因城堡旁发展。一〇七四年的文书记载了一处名为尤丁堡的集市，当时犹太商人在阿尔卑斯贸易中发挥重要作用。一二二四年，城镇获得城市权，后来成为与威尼斯贸易的中心。商人经营施蒂里亚的铁，以及用作香料的高山缬草。

一四六〇年，腓特烈三世授予尤登堡缬草贸易的专营权，城市保有这一权利超过一个世纪。犹太社群在居住区有会堂和洁净浴池，城外还有墓地。十四、十五世纪多次遭到迫害后，马克西米利安一世于一四九六年下令驱逐施蒂里亚的犹太人。曾帮助塑造城镇商业的社群被迫离开。

english:
Juegang was a salt-producing settlement in the coastal country of Jiangsu, historically belonging to Rugao county. From the Song through the Qing period it was known as Juegang salt field. Its administrative identity consequently grew around salt production as well as the settlement itself. The older name Juegang Ting reached back to the Tang period.

Under the Ming, a patrol inspectorate was established here. The Yangzhou prefectural gazetteer of 1664 lists Juegang's inspectorate 130 li east of Rugao's county seat, preserving its place in the county's early Qing administrative geography. A deputy county official was also stationed at Juegang during the Qing. Salt-field designation, patrol jurisdiction and a resident county official were successive features of this locality's history.
simp_chinese:
掘港位于江苏沿海，历史上隶属如皋县，是一处以产盐著称的聚落。唐代已有掘港亭之名，宋至清称掘港场。盐场名称长期沿用，使当地的行政身份与盐业生产密切相连。

明代在这里设置掘港巡检司。康熙三年即1664年的《扬州府志》，将其列在如皋县治以东一百三十里，留下了清初县域行政地理中的具体位置。清代又有县主簿驻在掘港。这些记载呈现了盐场聚落兼有地方官署的历史面貌：产盐之场、巡检辖地和驻官之所，是掘港在清代的几重身份。

english:
Juffure belonged to the Mandinka trading landscape of Niumi on the northern side of the Gambia River. African merchants there dealt with Europeans who maintained establishments on the river and its banks. Nearby San Domingo supplied fresh water to James Island and provided a meeting place for African and European traders. The mainland communities therefore sustained commercial relationships extending beyond the island fort itself.

Albreda, next to Juffure, was rented to French traders in 1681 and became their trading station. Along with San Domingo it served as an outlet for Niumi's commerce and for long-distance routes reaching the interior. Juffure's Mandinka traders formed part of this cluster of settlements, where different European companies sought access through local African counterparts. The district's Atlantic commerce included the slave trade, linking the riverbank communities to the coercive movement of people as well as the exchange of merchandise.
simp_chinese:
朱富雷属于冈比亚河北侧尼乌米的曼丁卡商业地域。非洲商人在此与驻留河中岛屿和两岸据点的欧洲人交易。附近的圣多明戈向詹姆斯岛供应淡水，也是非洲与欧洲商人会面的地方。因此，河岸社群所维持的商业关系，远远超出岛上堡垒本身。

与朱富雷相邻的阿尔布雷达于1681年租给法国商人，成为法国贸易站。它与圣多明戈共同充当尼乌米商业及通往内陆长途路线的出口。朱富雷的曼丁卡商人属于这一聚落群，欧洲各公司须通过当地非洲交易伙伴取得商业联系。区域大西洋贸易也包括奴隶买卖，使沿河社群卷入货物交换，以及强迫人口迁移。这片河岸的历史由本地商业网络、欧洲据点与跨洋贩运共同构成。

english: The Juǀʼhoansi are a San people of the Kalahari country of northeastern Namibia and neighbouring Botswana. Their language belongs to the ǃKung group and uses a rich range of click consonants. Mongongo nuts and tsin beans are among the plants gathered in the Nyae Nyae country. Juǀʼhoan hunters carry small bows and arrows, whose poison can be made from the larvae of beetles found in the Kalahari.
simp_chinese: 朱霍安西人是纳米比亚东北部及相邻博茨瓦纳卡拉哈里地区的桑人。他们的语言属于孔语群，拥有丰富的搭嘴辅音。尼艾尼艾地区可供采集的植物包括蒙贡果和钦豆。朱霍安猎人携带小型弓箭，箭毒可以用卡拉哈里甲虫的幼虫制成。

english: Juiz de Fora lies in the Paraibuna valley, along the Caminho Novo between the goldfields of Minas Gerais and Rio de Janeiro. Opened in the early eighteenth century, this road carried people and supplies as well as precious metal between the interior and the coast. Land grants and settlements followed its course. By 1784 Santo Antônio do Paraibuna was recorded among the places in the district, a forerunner of the town that grew here.
simp_chinese: 茹伊斯迪福拉位于帕拉伊布纳河谷，坐落在连接米纳斯吉拉斯金矿区与里约热内卢的“新路”沿线。这条道路于十八世纪初开通，在内陆与海岸之间运送人员、物资和贵金属。沿途出现了土地授予与聚落。到1784年，圣安东尼奥－杜帕拉伊布纳已见于当地记载，是此后发展起来的城镇的前身。

english:
Jujin was a Yuan-founded department retained by the Ming under Lijiang. The early-sixteenth-century Yunnan gazetteer placed it northwest of the prefectural seat, with the Jinsha River running through its country. It described the department as a strategic approach towards the Tibetan border and the northern iron-bridge routes.

The same gazetteer records that Jujin's government compound was built in 1391. It contained a clerk's hall, with pavilions for public moral instruction outside, as well as a welfare institution and a reserve granary. Such details reveal the offices and facilities through which Ming-era local government presented itself in this mountain district. The gazetteer also singled out pine nuts as a product of Jujin, a small local detail beside its account of frontier administration.
simp_chinese:
巨津是元代设置、明朝沿用的州，隶属丽江。16世纪初的《云南志》将其定位于府治西北，金沙江流经其境，并把这里视为通向吐蕃边地与北面铁桥道路的要地。

同一部地方志记载，巨津州官署建于1391年，内设吏目厅，外有旌善、申明二亭，以及养济院和预备仓。这些具体设施，展现出明代地方行政在山地州境中的组织与呈现方式。志书还特别标明松子产于巨津，在边地行政记述之外，留下了一项细小而具体的地方物产。

english:
The Jujuy valley lies where the mountain routes of northwestern Argentina descend towards greener eastern lands. It leads north to the Quebrada de Humahuaca, a corridor through which people and goods travelled between the high Andes and the valleys. Before Spanish settlement, the region was home to indigenous peoples including the Omaguacas.

Spanish attempts to found a town here met with resistance. The first settlement, Nieva, was established in 1561 but did not endure; a later foundation also failed. In 1593 Francisco de Argañaraz founded San Salvador de Jujuy, which survived. The colonial order brought grants of land and the allocation of conquered indigenous people to settlers, while the surrounding region remained a frontier of conflict throughout much of the seventeenth century.
simp_chinese:
胡胡伊河谷位于阿根廷西北部山路向东部较湿润地区下降之处。向北通往乌马瓦卡峡谷，这条通道连接安第斯高地与河谷，供人群和货物往来。西班牙人定居之前，包括奥马瓜卡人在内的原住民居住于此。

西班牙人在这里建城的尝试遭到抵抗。第一座聚落涅瓦建于1561年，未能持久；后一次建城也告失败。1593年，弗朗西斯科·德阿尔加尼亚拉斯建立的圣萨尔瓦多德胡胡伊得以存续。殖民秩序伴随着土地授予，以及将被征服的原住民分配给殖民者；十七世纪的大部分时间里，周边地区仍是冲突的边疆。

english:
Jukun here is the country of the Djugun, also written Djugan or Jugun, Aboriginal people of the coast around Broome in northwestern Australia, who spoke a dialect so close to Yawuru that the two peoples were distinguished only by minor differences. Their country faces Roebuck Bay, a shallow bay of red sandy beaches, mangroves and tidal creeks.

The northern shore of the bay, from Dampier Creek through the law grounds at Fishermans Bend to Crab Creek, was used for seasonal gatherings, gift exchange, marriage arrangements and the settlement of disputes. Shell middens along cliffs and dunes mark former camping places. The people lived on fish, turtles, stingrays, dugong and crabs from the sea and bush fruits and wallabies from the pindan scrub, marking the year by six seasons and trapping fish in stake-fenced rock ponds on the tidal flats. In 1699 William Dampier brought HMS Roebuck into the bay that now bears her name.
simp_chinese:
这里的朱昆（Jukun）是迪乌贡人（又写作 Djugan、Jugun）的土地，他们是澳大利亚西北部布鲁姆一带沿海的原住民，所说的方言与亚乌鲁语非常接近，两者之间只有细微差别。他们的土地面向罗巴克湾，这是一处浅湾，有红色沙滩、红树林和潮汐小溪。

海湾北岸从丹皮尔溪，经渔人湾的传统律法场所，延伸到蟹溪，曾用于季节性聚会、交换礼物、安排婚姻和解决争端。海崖与沙丘沿线的贝冢标示了过去的宿营地点。人们以海里的鱼、海龟、魟鱼、儒艮和螃蟹，以及平达灌丛里的野果和小袋鼠为食，一年分为六个季节，并在潮滩上用木桩围起石塘捕鱼。1699年，威廉·丹皮尔驾皇家海军“罗巴克号”驶入这个后来以该船命名的海湾。

english: Julah stands on the northern coast of Bali, where the island faces the Java Sea. Inscriptions preserved in nearby Sembiran record the village and its people in the tenth and eleventh centuries. Archaeological finds show that the coast around Julah and Sembiran took part in long-distance maritime exchange, making it one of the early gateways between Bali and the wider island world. The inscriptions also reveal the authority of Balinese rulers over local communities and trade.
simp_chinese: 茱拉位于巴厘岛北岸，面向爪哇海。邻近森比兰保存的铭文记载了十至十一世纪的村庄及其居民。考古发现表明，茱拉与森比兰附近海岸参与过远距离海上贸易，是巴厘岛与更广阔群岛世界之间的早期门户之一。铭文也展现出巴厘统治者对地方社区与贸易的权威。

english:
Julau is a tributary valley in the Rajang basin of Sarawak. Its river enters the Kanowit system, connecting inland country with the greater Rajang waterway. The history of the later town and its Chinese rubber traders belongs chiefly to the twentieth century. For 1337–1837 the appropriate setting is the changing society of the river basin, rather than that later market settlement.

Iban traditions trace migration from the upper Kapuas country into Sarawak from around the middle of the sixteenth century. Early routes led through Batang Ai and the Batang Lupar country; by the early nineteenth century migrants were moving into the Rajang basin and its southern tributaries. This regional movement does not supply an exact founding date for Julau. Longhouse households combined rice grown under shifting cultivation with hunting and gathering. River-based identities, kinship, warfare and the search for cultivable land shaped settlement. The basin consequently contained changing communities and claims to land, not an unvarying population defined by modern district boundaries. Julau's early history belongs within these movements between forest clearings and interconnected rivers.
simp_chinese:
如楼是砂拉越拉让江流域的一条支流河谷。河水进入加拿逸河系，将内陆同拉让江干流连接起来。后来城镇及华人橡胶商人的历史主要属于二十世纪。对于1337至1837年，更合适的背景是河流流域不断变化的社会。

伊班传统将其迁徙起点追溯至上卡普阿斯地区，约从十六世纪中叶开始进入砂拉越。早期路线经过峇当艾和鲁巴河地区；十九世纪初，移民逐渐进入拉让江流域及其南部支流。这种区域性迁徙，不能提供如楼聚落确切的建立年份。长屋中的家庭把轮歇耕作的稻田同狩猎、采集结合起来。以河流为基础的身份、亲属关系、战争及寻找可耕土地的需要，共同塑造居住格局。流域中的社群和土地权利因此持续变化，不能用现代行政区边界假定数百年间人口不变。如楼的早期背景属于这种森林耕地与相连水道之间的人群流动。

english: Julau lies in the forested lake country of eastern Borneo, near Jempang and the Mahakam River. The Mahakam flows from the island's highlands towards the Makassar Strait, receiving water from a network of tributaries and lakes along its course. Seasonal changes in water level alter the extent of the floodplain around Jempang.
simp_chinese: 珠劳位于婆罗洲东部森林湖泊地带，靠近金榜湖与马哈坎河。马哈坎河从岛屿高地流向望加锡海峡，沿途接纳支流与湖泊的水。水位的季节变化使金榜湖周围洪泛平原的范围随之改变。

english:
Old Julfa occupied a narrow rocky strip on the left bank of the Aras, southeast of Nakhchivan. In the sixteenth century it became an important Armenian centre for the raw-silk trade. Routes connecting Tabriz, Yerevan, Erzurum and Tbilisi attracted settlers and merchants, while dated cemetery monuments preserve evidence of the town's growth. Its commercial relationships extended across political frontiers.

That prosperity ended abruptly during the Ottoman–Safavid war. Shah Abbas I passed through Julfa in 1603 and received the hospitality of its merchants. Faced with an Ottoman counter-offensive the following year, he withdrew using a scorched-earth policy. Julfa was demolished and its inhabitants forced across the Aras into Iran in the autumn of 1604. The displaced community re-established itself at New Julfa beside Isfahan in 1605, carrying its commercial experience into a new setting under Safavid supervision. Old Julfa's history thereafter bore the rupture of forced removal: the merchant network continued, while the riverbank town from which it had developed was destroyed.
simp_chinese:
旧朱尔法坐落在阿拉斯河左岸、纳希切万东南的一条狭窄岩地。十六世纪，它成为亚美尼亚生丝贸易的重要中心。连接大不里士、埃里温、埃尔祖鲁姆与第比利斯的道路吸引居民和商人，有纪年的墓碑保存了城镇增长的证据，商业关系跨越不同政权边界。

奥斯曼与萨法维战争使繁荣骤然中断。阿巴斯一世于1603年经过朱尔法，受到商人款待。次年面对奥斯曼反攻，他撤军并实行焦土政策；1604年秋，城镇被毁，居民被迫渡过阿拉斯河迁入伊朗。迁出社群于1605年在伊斯法罕旁重建新朱尔法，将商业经验带入萨法维监管下的新环境。商贸网络由此延续，但其发源的河岸城镇遭到摧毁，强迫迁徙成为当地历史的重大断裂。

english:
Julfar was a trading town on the southern shore of the Persian Gulf, near the Strait of Hormuz. Its medieval quarters at Mataf and Nudud occupied sandbanks sheltering a lagoon, with palm gardens inland. The port was a source of pearls and a gateway for northern Oman, connected by sea to merchants from the Middle East, Africa, India and farther east.

Settlement shifted to the coast after the earlier harbour at Kush silted up. Excavations at Mataf and Nudud have revealed early houses of palm fronds, followed by mudbrick and stone buildings, narrow lanes, courtyard houses, a mosque and a fort. During the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries Julfar flourished under Hormuzi rule, producing valuable taxes and pearls. Local pottery travelled widely through the Gulf and Indian Ocean, while imported Chinese ceramics reached the town. The lagoon eventually silted up as well; by the middle of the sixteenth century Ras al-Khaimah had become Julfar's main port. The later history of Julfar under Portuguese influence centred on that settlement, which became a seat of the Qawasim family in the seventeenth century.
simp_chinese:
佐尔法是波斯湾南岸靠近霍尔木兹海峡的贸易城镇。中世纪的马塔夫和努杜德街区位于保护潟湖的沙洲上，内陆则有棕榈园。港口出产珍珠，也是阿曼北部的海上门户，与中东、非洲、印度及更远东方的商人相通。

库什的旧港淤塞后，聚落迁向海岸。马塔夫和努杜德的发掘发现了早期棕榈叶房屋，后来则有泥砖和石造建筑、狭巷、庭院住宅、清真寺与堡垒。十四至十五世纪，佐尔法在霍尔木兹统治下繁荣，提供可观的税收和珍珠。当地陶器远销海湾和印度洋各地，中国进口瓷器也运抵此处。潟湖后来同样淤塞；到十六世纪中叶，拉斯海马成为佐尔法的主要港口。葡萄牙势力下的后期佐尔法历史以这座聚落为中心，十七世纪它又成为卡瓦西姆家族的一个统治中心。

english:
The Julian Alps contained routes, mountain pastures and high summits that drew increasing scientific interest in the eighteenth century. Triglav, the range's highest peak, became the focus of a sustained attempt to reach and describe the high mountains. The naturalist Balthasar Hacquet tried to climb it in 1777 by way of Konjščica and Velo Polje.

In 1778 four men from Bohinj reached the summit: Lovro Wilomitzer, Štefan Rožič, Matevž Kos and Luka Korošec. Their ascent, encouraged by the industrialist and patron of science Sigmund Zois, became the first documented successful climb. The episode brought local mountain knowledge together with Enlightenment curiosity about the Alps. Hunters and other inhabitants supplied practical experience of the terrain, while naturalists and patrons helped turn a difficult summit into an object of organized exploration.
simp_chinese:
尤利安山间分布着道路、山地牧场与高峰，十八世纪逐渐引起更多科学兴趣。山脉最高峰特里格拉夫，成为人们持续尝试攀登和认识高山的目标。1777年，博物学家巴尔塔萨·阿凯特尝试经孔伊什契察与韦洛波列登山。

1778年，四名博希尼当地人登顶：洛夫罗·维洛米策、什特凡·罗日奇、马泰夫日·科斯与卢卡·科罗舍茨。这次由实业家、科学赞助人西格蒙德·佐伊斯推动的攀登，成为首个有文献记录的成功登顶。事件把当地山地知识与启蒙时代对阿尔卑斯山的好奇联系起来：猎人和居民提供熟悉地形的实际经验，博物学家与赞助者则推动有组织的高峰探索。

english: At La Junta, the Río Conchos joins the Rio Grande amid a fertile stretch of the desert. Indigenous farming villages stood along both rivers, and the Julimes were among the peoples recorded in the region. In 1683 Jumano leader Juan Sabeata travelled to El Paso to request missionaries. Spanish friars soon came to La Junta, but their stay was troubled, and the peoples of the river settlements repeatedly resisted outside control.
simp_chinese: 在拉洪塔，孔乔斯河汇入格兰德河，沙漠中因此出现一片肥沃地带。原住民农耕村落沿两条河分布，胡利梅人是这一带见于记载的族群之一。1683年，胡马诺领袖胡安·萨韦亚塔前往埃尔帕索，请求派遣传教士。西班牙修士随后来到拉洪塔，但他们的驻留并不安稳，河岸聚落的居民多次抵抗外来控制。

english:
Julu's county town stood in a sandy landscape where walls and drainage required repeated attention. The loose soil made its defences liable to collapse, while the moat readily filled with sediment. Repairs and dredging were therefore recurring tasks. In 1577 magistrate Zhang Dongxiao rebuilt the town walls, one episode in the continuing work needed to maintain a defended county centre.

Water management also extended beyond the walls. During major flooding in 1501, magistrate Tang Ze undertook extensive embankment works around the county to relieve the population's difficulties. Changes in the Zhang River's courses could unsettle the surrounding plain and demanded responses at a scale larger than the town itself. Julu's Ming history thus joined urban fortification to the maintenance of its wider watery landscape, with county officials directing works against both unstable ground and damaging floods.
simp_chinese:
巨鹿县城处在多沙地带，城墙与排水设施需要反复维护。土质松浮使城垣容易倾颓，护城河也容易淤塞，修葺与疏浚因而成为持续事务。1577年，知县张东晓重修城墙，是地方官维持设防县治的具体工程之一。

治水范围也超出城垣。1501年大水期间，知县唐泽大修堤障，环绕县境，以缓解居民困境。漳河河道的变迁能够扰动周围平原，要求比县城更大范围的应对。巨鹿明代的地方历史由此把城市防御与县域水患治理联系起来：城墙须抵抗松沙造成的损坏，田野、居民点又需应对洪水，地方官组织的工程共同作用于城内外景观。

english: The Jumentos Cays form a curved chain of low islands along the southern edge of the Great Bahama Bank. Shallow water and reefs surround the cays, which extend toward Ragged Island. The name Jumento is among the Indigenous names preserved in the Bahamian archipelago. To the south lie Cuba and the Old Bahama Channel, while the sheltered bank stretches north toward the larger islands of the Bahamas.
simp_chinese: 胡门托礁岛沿大巴哈马浅滩南缘排列成弧形，低矮的岛屿周围环绕着浅水与礁石，向拉格德岛方向延伸。胡门托是巴哈马群岛保存下来的原住民地名之一。南面是古巴与老巴哈马海峡，受庇护的浅滩则向北伸展，通往巴哈马较大的岛屿。

english: The Jumgal flows through a broad valley in the inner Tian Shan, between the Jumgal Too range to the north and Moldo Too to the south. Its waters join the Kökömeren and continue to the Naryn, part of the great Syr Darya system. Mountain ridges enclose the valley, while its river and open floor form a corridor through the high country.
simp_chinese: 朱姆加尔河流经天山腹地的宽阔河谷，北面是朱姆加尔山，南面是莫尔多山。河水汇入克克梅伦河，再流向纳伦河，属于锡尔河庞大水系。山脊环抱河谷，河流和开阔谷底则在高地之间形成一条通道。

english: Jumilla lies among the dry hills of southeastern Iberia, beneath a castle commanding the town. An earlier Muslim fortress occupied the height before Jumilla passed to the lordship of Villena in 1445. In the fifteenth century Juan Pacheco, Marquis of Villena, rebuilt the stronghold to suit the weapons of his age. Its great keep proclaimed the authority of the marquises over the surrounding lands.
simp_chinese: 胡米利亚坐落在伊比利亚东南部干燥的丘陵间，城堡居高俯瞰城镇。1445年城镇归入比列纳领地之前，高地上已有一座穆斯林要塞。15世纪，比列纳侯爵胡安·帕切科重建城堡，使其适应当时的武器。高大的主塔彰显着侯爵对周边土地的权力。

english:
Jumla was a major centre among the western Himalayan principalities known as the Baise states. It inherited part of the political world of the Khasa Malla kingdom, whose power reached a high point under Prithvi Malla in the mid-fourteenth century. As that larger realm fragmented, Jumla remained influential in the Karnali country and maintained relations with neighbouring mountain kingdoms.

The kingdom's reach was felt in Mustang, which came under Jumla's influence at different times in the sixteenth and eighteenth centuries. Its independence ended during the Gorkhali expansion. Forces attacked in 1787, and after prolonged resistance Jumla was conquered in 1789. The names of its last ruler vary between chronicles and later accounts, but the fall of the kingdom marked the end of an important centre of western Himalayan power. The valley's royal documents and chronicles preserve a regional history that extends beyond the later boundaries of Nepal.
simp_chinese:
久姆拉是喜马拉雅山西部“二十二国”中的重要中心，继承了迦舍末罗王国的部分政治遗产。这个更大的王国在十四世纪中叶普里特维·末罗统治时达到强盛阶段；随着其分裂，久姆拉仍在格尔纳利地区保持影响，与周围山地王国往来。

它的影响也延伸至木斯塘；十六和十八世纪的不同时期，木斯塘曾处于久姆拉势力之下。廓尔喀扩张最终结束了王国独立。军队于1787年进攻，久姆拉经过持续抵抗后，于1789年被征服。编年史和后来的记述对末代君主称名不一，但王国的覆亡结束了喜马拉雅西部一个重要权力中心的独立历史。河谷留存的王室文书与史书，记录了超越尼泊尔后来国界的区域联系。

english:
Junagarh stood below the Girnar hills in Saurashtra, with Uparkot Fort overlooking the town. The Chudasama rulers held this centre until Mahmud Begada of Gujarat conquered it in the early 1470s. Under the sultans, Junagarh was also known as Mustafabad. An appointed commander collected tribute and crown revenues, placing the town within the political arrangements directed from Ahmedabad.

Mughal expansion into Gujarat in 1573 brought a further layer of authority. Junagarh remained a centre for governing Sorath, while local military officials negotiated power within the larger empire. As Mughal control weakened in the eighteenth century, Sher Khan Babi established a separate ruling house in the late 1740s. The successive governments reused a fortified urban centre with its own regional hinterland. The history of the town therefore involved both conquest and administrative continuity: the fort and the collection of revenue remained important even as Chudasama kings, Gujarat sultans, Mughal officials and Babi rulers occupied different positions in the regional hierarchy.
simp_chinese:
朱纳格特坐落在萨乌拉施特拉吉尔纳尔山下，乌帕尔科特堡俯瞰城镇。楚达萨马王朝掌握这里，直到十五世纪七十年代初被古吉拉特苏丹马哈茂德·贝加达征服。苏丹统治时期，城镇也称穆斯塔法巴德，受任的军事官员征收贡赋与王室收入，使其纳入艾哈迈达巴德主导的政治安排。

1573年莫卧儿扩张进入古吉拉特，又增加一层帝国权威。朱纳格特继续作为索拉特地方中心，军事官员在更大帝国内经营自身权力。十八世纪莫卧儿控制衰弱后，舍尔汗·巴比于四十年代后期建立独立统治家族。不同政府反复利用同一设防城镇及其腹地，征服与行政延续相互交织。楚达萨马诸王、古吉拉特苏丹、莫卧儿官员与巴比统治者更替，堡垒和征税职能仍保持重要地位。

english: Jundiaí lies in the uplands of São Paulo, on routes that led colonial settlers away from the coast and into the interior. Portuguese colonists arrived in the early seventeenth century, and a settlement grew around the parish of Nossa Senhora do Desterro. In 1656 it was elevated to a town, gaining a council and a place in the administration of the expanding captaincy.
simp_chinese: 容迪亚伊位于圣保罗高地，坐落在殖民者离开海岸、进入内陆的道路上。葡萄牙殖民者于十七世纪初抵达，聚落围绕流亡圣母堂区发展。1656年，这里升格为镇，设立议会，成为不断扩张的总督领行政体系的一部分。

english:
The wooded country around Jundiaí lay on the advancing frontier of Portuguese settlement in São Vicente. Indigenous communities cultivated maize and manioc before colonists entered the region in the early seventeenth century. Newcomers adopted local building practices and the use of fire in cultivation, while their expansion drove some inhabitants farther into the forest.

The settlement of Nossa Senhora do Desterro became a vila on 14 December 1656. Its wider countryside served expeditions and muleteers moving into the interior, and small farms supplied travellers as well as the town. Grants of land divided the region into sesmarias. Enslaved Indigenous labour sustained much of this economy before the growing use of enslaved Africans during the eighteenth century. Forest, farmland and routes of movement consequently belonged to the same colonial frontier. The woodland surrounding Jundiaí offered refuge to displaced people while also lying within a countryside increasingly drawn into settlement, provisioning and coercive labour.
simp_chinese:
容迪亚伊周围的林地，位于圣维森特葡萄牙殖民扩展的边缘。十七世纪初殖民者进入以前，原住民社群在此种植玉米与木薯。移民采用部分地方建筑技术和烧垦方法，其扩张也迫使一些居民退入森林。

德斯特罗圣母聚落于1656年12月14日升为镇。更广阔的乡间服务于深入内陆的探险队与骡队，小农场既供应镇民，也供应旅人；授地制度将地域划为sesmaria地产。被奴役的原住民长期承担重要劳动，十八世纪又逐渐增加非洲奴隶。因此，森林、农地与通行道路同属一片殖民边地。林地为遭驱逐者提供藏身之处，同时也处在不断扩展的定居、补给及强制劳役体系周围。

english: Jungaa is a recorded name associated with the Kalamaia people of Western Australia's inland country. It means people or men in the recorded terminology. Kalamaia country includes parts of the Wheatbelt and Goldfields, where woodland and dry plains form a landscape known through Aboriginal languages and named places.
simp_chinese: 琼加是与西澳大利亚内陆卡拉迈亚人有关的记载名称，在所记录的用法中意为人。卡拉迈亚人的土地包括麦田区和金矿区的部分地区，林地与干旱平原构成原住民语言和地名所熟悉的景观。

english: Jungal is one of the recorded names associated with the Kalamaia people of Western Australia's inland Wheatbelt and Goldfields. Their country includes dry plains and woodland between the southwestern settlements and the desert country farther east. Different names in the historical record reflect the linguistic diversity of neighbouring Aboriginal communities.
simp_chinese: 琼加尔是与西澳大利亚内陆麦田区和金矿区卡拉迈亚人有关的记载名称之一。其土地包括西南地区与更东部沙漠之间的干旱平原和林地。历史记载中的不同名称反映了邻近原住民社群的语言多样性。

english: Jungfrauen Island lies south of the Gulf of Penas, at the Pacific entrance to the intricate channels of western Patagonia. It is the largest of a group of islands, islets and rocks in the Wellington Archipelago. Navigators approaching this broken coast faced a maze of passages between islands and the mainland. Early charts portrayed much of the region as a single great island, reflecting how slowly its complicated geography was understood by European sailors.
simp_chinese: 荣弗劳恩岛位于佩纳斯湾以南，扼守巴塔哥尼亚西部曲折水道的太平洋入口。它是惠灵顿群岛内一组岛屿、礁岩中最大的一座。接近这片破碎海岸的航海者，面对的是岛屿与大陆之间迷宫般的航道。早期地图曾把这一带的大部分画成一座巨岛，反映出欧洲航海者对其复杂地理的认识是如何逐渐形成的。

english:
Junghwa lay south of Pyongyang within the administrative and military world of northwestern Korea. Its county government had already risen in rank under Goryeo: in 1371 its chief official became a jigunsa, a fourth-rank appointment. Joseon reorganized that office as a gunsu in 1466, retaining Junghwa as a county governed by a centrally appointed magistrate.

The Japanese invasions brought a more conspicuous promotion. In 1593 Junghwa became a dohobu in recognition of local resistance to the invaders, with a third-rank dohobusa at its head. The magistrate also held military responsibilities within the Pyongyang command structure. The eighteenth-century Yeojidoseo describes a government staffed by clerks and attendants, with military and courier officers and enslaved men and women attached to it. Junghwa's place in the kingdom depended on this combination of civil administration and defence: the same office managed local affairs, maintained communications and answered to the military authorities of Pyongyang.
simp_chinese:
中和位于平壤以南，属于朝鲜西北部的行政与军事体系。高丽时期，其县政机构已经升格：1371年，地方长官改为四品知郡事。朝鲜王朝于1466年将这一官职改称郡守，中和继续由中央任命的地方官治理。

壬辰倭乱带来了更显著的晋升。1593年，朝廷为表彰当地抵抗日军，将中和升为都护府，由三品都护府使主持。地方长官同时承担军事职责，隶属平壤的军政体系。十八世纪《舆地图书》记载，中和官署设有吏员、侍从、军官和驿传人员，并役使附属的男女奴婢。民政与防御由此集中于同一机构：它处理地方事务、维持公文与人员往来，也接受平壤军事长官的节制。

english: The southern Patagonian steppe around the Gallegos Chico was travelled by Aónikenk hunters. South of the river lies Potrok Aike, a nearly circular lake filling a volcanic crater amid the dry grassland. Guanacos supplied the Aónikenk with meat and hides. By the eighteenth century horses had become important to their journeys: in 1766 French sailors near Cape Gregory encountered Aónikenk riders and exchanged goods for cloaks and ornaments.
simp_chinese: 加列戈斯奇科河周围的巴塔哥尼亚南部草原，是奥尼肯克猎人往来的地方。河流以南的波特罗克艾克湖近乎圆形，填满干草原上的一座火山口。原驼为奥尼肯克人提供肉和兽皮。十八世纪时，马已成为他们旅行的重要伙伴：1766年，法国水手在格雷戈里角附近遇到奥尼肯克骑手，以货物交换披风和饰物。

english:
The Juniata valley offered an east–west passage through central Pennsylvania's ridges long before the canal era. Indigenous paths and settlements occupied the river country; a Native village at the junction with Standing Stone Creek was described in 1754. Colonial settlement expanded amid land purchases and competing claims, while farming communities developed along the more accessible valley floors.

In the early nineteenth century, the same terrain became central to Pennsylvania's attempt to connect Philadelphia and Pittsburgh. The legislature authorised the Lower Juniata Division of the state canal on 9 April 1827, and construction began in July 1828. Lewistown Narrows demanded lift locks and substantial retaining walls, making this constricted passage especially expensive. The lower division opened in 1830, and by November 1832 the full Juniata Division reached Hollidaysburg. Faulty locks and aqueducts still required repairs before full operation the following year. The river corridor was becoming an engineered transport route, with navigation dependent on construction, water supply and continual maintenance.
simp_chinese:
朱尼亚塔河谷在运河时代以前，已是穿过宾夕法尼亚中部山脊的东西通道。原住民道路与聚落分布于沿河地区，1754年有人记述了斯坦丁斯通溪汇入口的一处原住民村落。殖民定居伴随土地购买与彼此冲突的权利主张扩展，农耕聚落沿较便于利用的谷地成长。

十九世纪初，同样的地形成为宾夕法尼亚连接费城与匹兹堡计划的关键。1827年4月9日，州议会批准下朱尼亚塔运河段，1828年7月开工。刘易斯敦峡口需要船闸与大型挡土墙，狭窄通道的造价尤其高。下段于1830年完工，整个朱尼亚塔运河段则于1832年11月贯通至霍利迪斯堡；部分船闸与渡槽因施工缺陷，次年仍需修复后才能全面运营。天然河谷由此成为经过改造的运输走廊，航运依靠工程、供水和持续维护。

sources.title: Draft EA Section 3 - Cassville Concord Nossville Three Springs and Tuscarora Mountain.pdf

english:
The mouth of the Junk River on the Liberian coast became the subject of negotiations with the American colonisation settlement in October 1826. The colony sought a station on the peninsula between the Junk and Red Junk rivers, intended for a trading factory and a resident colonial agent. Local leaders included Prince Will of the Junk, Tom of the Red Junk, Peter Harris, Tom French and Junk Pepper.

The commissioners’ initial proposal to purchase part of the peninsula failed at a council on 10 October. A different arrangement followed on the next day: a perpetual grant of use and jurisdiction over a defined tract at the river mouths. The colonial report itself recorded the chiefs’ distrust of the settlement’s intentions. This encounter reveals a contested negotiation over a particular landing and trading place, rather than an uncontested transfer of an empty coast.
simp_chinese:
利比里亚海岸的琼克河口在1826年十月成为当地首领与美国殖民安置点谈判的对象。殖民当局希望在琼克河与红琼克河之间的半岛设立贸易站，并派驻代理人。参与谈判的地方领袖包括琼克河的普林斯·威尔、红琼克河的汤姆，以及彼得·哈里斯、汤姆·弗伦奇和琼克·佩珀。

10月10日的会议没有接受殖民代表购买部分半岛的提议。次日，双方转而达成另一种安排，将河口一片划定土地的使用和管辖权作永久授予。殖民方报告本身也记载了首领们对其意图的不信任。这一事件展示了围绕具体河口与贸易据点展开的争议性谈判。

english:
Junnar lies beneath the hill fort of Shivneri near routes across the Western Ghats. It is one of the old trading towns of the western Deccan, connected by the Naneghat pass with ports on the Konkan coast. Buddhist caves cut into the surrounding hills preserve inscriptions naming donors and trading communities. Their presence recalls the town’s place in networks that carried goods between the coast and the plateau.

Shivneri became a fortress of the Deccan sultanates. In 1630 Jijabai gave birth there to Shivaji, son of Shahaji Bhonsle, and mother and child spent his early years in its shelter. Shivaji later built an independent Maratha power amid the struggles of the Deccan. Junnar itself was drawn into those conflicts: in 1657 his men surprised and plundered the town, carrying away money, horses and goods. Its ancient caves and formidable hill fort represent two different periods of Junnar’s long history.
simp_chinese:
朱纳尔位于希夫内里山堡下方，靠近穿越西高止山脉的道路。它是德干西部古老的贸易城镇之一，经过纳内加特山口与贡坎海岸港口相连。周围山丘中开凿的佛教石窟保存着记载捐赠者和商人社群的铭文，反映出此地曾参与连接海岸与高原的贸易网络。

希夫内里后来成为德干苏丹国的一座要塞。1630年，吉贾拜在堡内生下沙哈吉·邦斯莱之子希瓦吉，母子在此度过了他的童年早期。希瓦吉后来在德干的争斗中建立独立的马拉塔势力。朱纳尔自身也卷入冲突：1657年，他的部众突袭并劫掠城镇，带走钱财、马匹和货物。古代石窟与险峻山堡代表着朱纳尔漫长历史中的不同时期。

english: The North Fork of the Malheur River descends from the Blue Mountains through a broad upper valley and a steep, rugged canyon. Farther south it joins the Malheur, whose waters continue east to the Snake River. This country lies between the mountains and the northern Great Basin, in the wider homeland of the Northern Paiute, whose bands drew on the resources of valleys, rivers and uplands.
simp_chinese: 马卢尔河北支从蓝山流下，穿过开阔的上游河谷和一段险峻的峡谷。在更南方，它汇入马卢尔河，后者继续向东流入斯内克河。这片土地位于山地与大盆地北部之间，是北派尤特人广阔故土的一部分；他们的各支族利用河谷、河流和高地的资源维持生活。

english:
Juque was the old name for an area in northern Yunnan. Its historical setting was the jurisdiction of Dayao and Yao'an. Local chronology places Dayao under Yao'an in the Yuan period and records the Ming establishment of Yao'an Prefecture in 1382. In 1394 that administration became a military and civilian prefecture.

The early Qing retained Dayao's connection with Yao'an. In 1730 Yao'an came under the Yixi circuit, whose seat was at Dali. A further change in 1770 abolished Yao'an Prefecture and transferred Dayao to Chuxiong Prefecture. In 1823 a separate inspection administration was established at Juque in northern Dayao.
simp_chinese:
苴却是云南北部一带的旧称。理解其历史，应放在大姚、姚安的管辖关系中。地方沿革记载，元代大姚隶属姚安；明代1382年设姚安府，1394年改为姚安军民府。

清初沿袭大姚隶属姚安的关系。1730年，姚安归入驻大理的迤西道。1770年又撤销姚安府，将大姚转隶楚雄府。1823年，在大姚北部的苴却设置分治的巡检行政。

english: Jurbarkas stands where the Mituva and Imsrė meet the Nemunas, a river that carried traffic west towards Prussia. Its name recalls Georgenburg, a castle established by the Teutonic Order in 1259 during its campaigns against Lithuania. The stronghold formed part of a contested chain of fortifications along the Nemunas. Vytautas destroyed Georgenburg in 1403, and the Treaty of Melno confirmed the area as Lithuanian in 1422. Jurbarkas later grew as a river trading town, exporting timber downstream to Prussia. It received municipal rights in 1611. In 1831, during the uprising against Russian rule, insurgents briefly took the town, bringing another conflict to the old frontier on the Nemunas.
simp_chinese: 尤尔巴尔卡斯位于米图瓦河、伊姆斯雷河与涅曼河交汇处；涅曼河向西通往普鲁士，是重要的水运通道。城镇的名字与格奥尔根堡有关，那是条顿骑士团于1259年进攻立陶宛时建立的城堡，属于涅曼河沿岸反复争夺的一系列要塞。维陶塔斯于1403年摧毁格奥尔根堡，1422年的梅尔诺条约确认这一带属于立陶宛。此后尤尔巴尔卡斯发展为河港商镇，木材顺流运往普鲁士，并于1611年取得城市自治权。1831年反抗俄国统治的起义期间，起义者曾短暂占领此地，战火再次来到涅曼河上的旧边疆。

english: Jurchi lay in the open steppe of northern Crimea, near the road from Perekop to Bakhchysarai. A small settlement recorded as Yurtchu in the late eighteenth century later bore the name Jurchi. Its position placed it between the fortified entrance to the peninsula and the inland seat of the Crimean khans. The level countryside around it formed part of the broad steppe that stretches south from the Perekop isthmus.
simp_chinese: 朱尔奇位于克里米亚北部开阔的草原上，靠近从彼列科普通往巴赫奇萨赖的道路。十八世纪末的文书将这里的小聚落记为尤尔丘，后来称为朱尔奇。它处在半岛设防入口与克里米亚汗国内陆都城之间，周围平坦地带是从彼列科普地峡向南延伸的广大草原的一部分。

english: Jurhen Ui stands in the cold highlands of western Hoh Xil, amid ridges and inland lake basins of the Tibetan Plateau. To the north, Lebxewudan Lake receives meltwater and springs from the surrounding mountains. Much of this remote region has no outlet to the sea; water collects in isolated lakes while sparse alpine vegetation supports wildlife adapted to great altitude.
simp_chinese: 觉尔恩山位于可可西里西部寒冷高地，周围是青藏高原的山脊与内陆湖盆。北方勒斜武担错接纳周围山地的冰川融水与泉水。这片偏远地区多无出海口，河水汇集成孤立湖泊，稀疏高山植被则供养适应高海拔的野生动物。

english:
Juris belongs to the Amazonian interior, where rivers connect forest communities. The Juri, also called Yuri, have been recorded in the country between the Içá and Japurá rivers of northwestern Brazil. Waterways provide routes through the forest, while fishing, gardens and woodland resources support different livelihoods.

Across the wider Amazon basin, Indigenous peoples maintained distinct languages and relationships through kinship and exchange. European expansion brought missions, slaving expeditions and disease, although these pressures affected river districts at different times. Communities responded through movement and changing relationships with their neighbours.
simp_chinese:
茹里斯属于亚马孙内陆，河流连接着森林中的社群。据记载，茹里人又称尤里人，生活在巴西西北部伊萨河与雅普拉河之间。水道提供穿越森林的路线，捕鱼、园地和林地资源支持不同的生计。

在更广阔的亚马孙流域，原住民族使用不同语言，通过亲属和交换保持联系。欧洲扩张带来传教、猎奴远征和疾病，但这些压力在不同时间影响各河区。社群通过迁徙及调整与邻人的关系作出回应。

english: The mountains of Las Jurisdicciones rise in the northern Colombian Andes, near the routes between Ocaña and the Catatumbo basin. Their ridges and valleys form part of the eastern cordillera, where streams descend toward the Magdalena and Lake Maracaibo. Mountain passes shaped travel between the colonial settlements of Ocaña, Pamplona and the lowlands, while forests covered the steep slopes between the valleys.
simp_chinese: 胡里斯迪克西奥内斯山位于哥伦比亚安第斯山北部，邻近奥卡尼亚与卡塔通博流域之间的道路。山脊与谷地属于东部山脉的一部分，溪流从这里流向马格达莱纳河和马拉开波湖。山口影响着奥卡尼亚、潘普洛纳等殖民聚落与低地之间的交通，森林覆盖谷地之间的陡坡。

english: Jurm lies on the upper Kokcha River in mountainous Badakhshan, upstream from the meeting of the Kokcha and Warduj. Farther up the valley, the mines of Sar-e Sang have yielded deep blue lapis lazuli for thousands of years. The stone travelled far beyond these mountains, and medieval accounts of Badakhshan preserved its reputation. The river valley offers a route through a country otherwise divided by high ranges.
simp_chinese: 朱尔姆位于巴达赫尚山区的科克恰河上游，在科克恰河与瓦尔杜吉河汇合处上方。更靠上游的萨雷桑矿山数千年来出产深蓝色青金石。宝石远销山外，中世纪关于巴达赫尚的记述也保留了它的名声。河谷穿过崇山阻隔的地区，形成一条通道。

english:
Jurong lies east of Nanjing, among the low hills and cultivated country of southern Jiangsu. At the beginning of the period it belonged to Jiqing Circuit under the Yuan. The Ming replacement of that circuit by Yingtian Prefecture kept Jurong within the jurisdiction of the southern imperial centre; under the Qing the prefecture was renamed Jiangning. Changes of dynasty therefore altered the administrative framework without removing the county's close connection to Nanjing.

The Maoshan hills gave the county a second, religious geography. Older Shangqing Daoist traditions associated the mountain with revelations, study and cultivation, and its palaces and temples continued to draw patrons and pilgrims. The mountain's resources also entered learned medicine. Li Shizhen's sixteenth-century Compendium of Materia Medica recorded medicinal plants associated with Maoshan, including its celebrated atractylodes. The county's history thus brought administrative ties to a major city together with a sacred landscape known beyond its immediate settlements. Officials, religious practitioners and those collecting or preparing medicinal materials encountered different aspects of the same hill country, whose reputation joined devotional and practical knowledge.
simp_chinese:
句容位于南京以东、江苏南部低山与耕地之间。元代属集庆路，明代改路为应天府，句容仍处于南方皇都的管辖范围；清代应天府改称江宁府，县的隶属关系相应变化。王朝更替改变行政框架，却没有使当地脱离同南京的紧密联系。

茅山又赋予县境另一层宗教地理。较早形成的上清道教传统，将山地同经典传授、修习和养生联系起来，宫观继续吸引施主与朝山者。山中资源也进入医学知识：李时珍的十六世纪《本草纲目》收录了同茅山相关的药材，其中包括著名的茅苍术。因此，句容历史一面连接大城市的行政体系，一面包含声名远播的神圣山地。官员、修道者与采集加工药材的人们，从不同角度利用和认识同一片丘陵；地方声望也将宗教实践与实用知识相互连接。

english: Wadi Jurrah, also known as Wadi Ahwar, crosses the southern Yemeni country toward the Gulf of Aden. It belongs to a landscape of dry valleys and hills where water gathers after rain and follows channels towards the coast. In Dathinah, inland routes meet the approaches to the coastal plain, linking the hill country with the shores of southern Arabia.
simp_chinese: 朱拉谷地又称阿赫瓦尔谷地，穿过也门南部，朝亚丁湾方向延伸。这里山丘与干谷相间，雨后的水汇入河道，流向海岸。在达西纳一带，内陆道路与通往沿海平原的路径交会，将丘陵地带与阿拉伯南部海岸相连。

english: Juru Hoton, known in Chinese as Shuangchengzi, lies in the Suifen valley amid the hills of eastern Manchuria. The valley formed part of the territory of Balhae, whose Suibin district was celebrated for fine horses. Later the Jurchen Jin ruled the region, and in the early thirteenth century the kingdom of Eastern Xia arose amid the wars that broke Jin power. Ancient fortified sites in the valley preserve traces of these successive states and their routes toward the coast.
simp_chinese: 双城子位于满洲东部山地间的绥芬河谷。这里曾属渤海国，率宾地区以良马闻名。后来女真金朝统治此地，十三世纪初，东夏政权在金朝衰败的战争中兴起。河谷中的古城遗址保留着这些相继出现的政权，以及通往海岸道路的痕迹。

english:
Jüterbog stood between Saxony, Brandenburg and Magdeburg, a position that brought princely meetings and religious controversy into the town. Its late medieval building programme included the Franciscan monastery and church, constructed between 1480 and 1510, and the town hall completed in 1507. Civic and ecclesiastical institutions shared an increasingly substantial urban setting.

In 1517 Johann Tetzel preached indulgences at St Nicholas's Church. These sermons became associated with the disputes that drove the Reformation, especially because Wittenberg lay nearby. From 1519 the town council commissioned reforming preachers, among them Thomas Müntzer. Political allegiance later changed as warfare reshaped the region: Jüterbog passed to Electoral Saxony in 1635 and to Prussia in 1815. The town's early modern history therefore combined decisions by its own council with religious disputes and territorial changes that reached far beyond the surrounding countryside.
simp_chinese:
于特博格处于萨克森、勃兰登堡与马格德堡之间，地理位置使诸侯会晤和宗教争论进入城中。中世纪晚期的营建包括1480至1510年间修筑的方济各会修道院及教堂，以及1507年完成的市政厅。市民与教会机构共同占据日益成形的城市空间。

1517年，约翰·台彻尔在圣尼古拉教堂宣讲赎罪券；由于城镇接近维滕贝格，这些活动与推动宗教改革的争论密切相连。1519年起，市议会委托改革派传道人活动，其中包括托马斯·闵采尔。此后，地区战争又改变政治归属：于特博格于1635年归入萨克森选侯国，1815年转属普鲁士。城镇自身的议会决策，因而与更广阔的信仰争论和领土变化交织。

english:
Juuka's eighteenth-century institutions developed within the inland parish landscape of northern Karelia. In 1741 a prayer-house community was formed from parts of the Pielisjärvi and Nurmes parishes. A church followed in 1748, giving inhabitants a local place of worship before an independent parish was established much later.

Documents creating Juuka's chapel congregation were drawn up at Pielisjärvi church on 10 June 1770. The consistory decided to appoint a chaplain in August 1771, and Gustav Lindblad received his commission on 13 April 1772. A cantor and sexton were appointed around the same period. These successive arrangements made Juuka a more substantial local religious centre while it remained connected to the older Pielisjärvi parish.
simp_chinese:
尤卡十八世纪的地方机构，形成于北卡累利阿内陆的教区格局之中。1741年，皮耶利斯耶尔维与努尔梅斯教区的部分地区组成祈祷堂社群。1748年建起教堂，在很久以后的独立教区成立之前，已为居民提供本地礼拜场所。

设立尤卡附属教区的文件于1770年6月10日在皮耶利斯耶尔维教堂订立。宗教法庭于1771年8月决定任命牧师，古斯塔夫·林德布拉德于1772年4月13日获得委任状。约在同一时期，当地又设置领唱与教堂司事职务。接续完成的安排，使尤卡成为更具规模的地方宗教中心，同时仍与原有的皮耶利斯耶尔维教区相联系。

english:
Juxeri was one of the Jurchen groups associated with the Changbai Mountain region. Its late sixteenth-century history belongs to a landscape of separate leaders and fortified communities, before Nurhaci's expanding state incorporated them. The name identifies a historical community and its territory, rather than a modern county whose boundaries can simply be carried back into the Ming period.

In 1593 Yulengge, the leader of Juxeri, joined the coalition against Nurhaci that brought together the Yehe, Hada, Ula and Hoifa rulers with Mongol and other allies. The coalition illustrates the ability of these communities to organise against a growing neighbour, as well as the pressures created by that neighbour's expansion. Juxeri was subsequently brought under Nurhaci's authority alongside other Changbai groups, including Neyen. These events formed part of a wider struggle over people, resources and access to Ming exchange. Commercial privileges and tribute documents mattered within that regional competition, but military conquest increasingly concentrated authority in the emerging Manchu polity.
simp_chinese:
朱舍里是同长白山地区有关的女真群体之一。其十六世纪末历史属于首领与筑防社群分立的景观，随后才被努尔哈赤扩张中的政权归并。这一名称指历史社群及其地域，不能直接套入现代县界来理解明代情况。

1593年，朱舍里首领尤楞额加入反对努尔哈赤的联盟，同叶赫、哈达、乌拉、辉发统治者及蒙古等其他力量合作。联盟既体现这些社群能够组织起来抵御扩张中的邻近势力，也体现后者扩张带来的压力。此后，朱舍里与讷殷等长白山群体相继进入努尔哈赤控制。这些事件属于围绕人口、资源及对明交换渠道的更大斗争。商业特权和朝贡凭证在区域竞争中具有价值，而军事征服正将权力越来越多地集中于形成中的满洲政权。

sources.title: Liang The Wealth of a Rising Empire OA.pdf

english:
Juxian stands in the hills of southeastern Shandong on the site of the old capital of the state of Ju, a Spring and Autumn power. When Yan's general Yue Yi swept through Qi in 284 BC and took more than seventy cities, only Ju and Jimo held out, and Tian Dan later won the kingdom back. In the Ming and Qing the town was the seat of Ju Department.

Its walls were rebuilt in 1511 and faced in brick in 1597. In 1668 the great earthquake along the Tan-Lu fault shook the whole department, killing perhaps twenty thousand people in Ju alone, and wrecked the walls; repairs began the next year. Over the following decades the gates were reoriented: in 1685 the east gate was turned to face north and the south gate to face west, and in 1760 a locally financed project restored both to their original directions. Magistrate Zhao Jinji divided the work into sections, and it took three years.
simp_chinese:
莒县坐落在山东东南部的丘陵之间，是春秋时莒国故都所在。公元前284年，燕将乐毅攻齐，连下七十余城，只有莒和即墨坚守，齐将田单后来收复了全国。明清时期，这里是莒州治所。

城墙在1511年重修，1597年改用砖砌。1668年，沿郯庐断裂带发生大地震，震动全州，莒州死亡约两万人，城垣被毁，次年开始修复。此后城门方向几经改动：1685年东门改朝北，南门改朝西；1760年地方集资修城，恢复了两座城门原来的朝向，知州赵晋基将工程分段派工，历时三年。

english:
Juxtlahuaca lay among the Mixtec communities of western Oaxaca. Dominican missionaries arriving in the 1530s encouraged people to leave hill settlements for the valley. The colonial town was established there on 13 September 1542. Indigenous leaders remained important: the cacique governor Lorenzo Suárez de Mendoza sought formal land titles for the community, obtaining them in 1585.

In 1592 the corregidor was instructed to mark boundaries and settle disputes with neighbouring Tecomaxtlahuaca. A Dominican house was established in 1595, while the town centre shifted northward in the early seventeenth century. The church of Santiago was built between 1620 and 1633.
